senses.gloss: --in the middle of चिन्तामणिग्रह: des- cribed. Br. IV. ३६. ४४; ३७. ३९-46.
--a son of मरीचि: his queen was सरघा and his son was Madhu. भा. V. १५. १५.
(I)--the Queen of मरीचि and mother of Bindumat. भा. V. १५. १५.

(II)--a daughter of शशबिन्दु (शतबिन्दु- वी। प्।) and queen of माम्धाता also known as Caitrarathi (s.v.) and mother of three sons, Mucukunda, अम्बरीष and पुरुकुत्श. भा. IX. 6. ३८; Vi. IV. 2. ६६; वा. ८८. ७०-2. [page२-484+ ३१]
(I)--a Kinnara with a human face. वा. ६९. ३६.
(II)--the son of Candragupta Maurya, and father of अशोकवर्धन. Vi. IV. २४. २९-30.
